title: Replenishment Floor Computation — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Treasury Note
content:
**Floor clause.** On a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service with automatic replenishment on, the replenishment floor is the tier's default low-balance alert level, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 50 that is not below it, so an amount that already is such a multiple is kept.

**Assembly clause.** The floor is built on that base amount: the base amount is raised once by the sum of every percentage that applies, the percentages being added together into one rate rather than applied one after another, and then rounded up to the nearest multiple of 50 that is not below it, an amount that already is such a multiple being kept.

The default low-balance alert level is the tier's alert level set at enrollment when the employer chooses none, as the tariff lists it for the tier the service holds.

## Rounding to a multiple of 50 (hypothetical amounts)

| Amount before rounding | Replenishment floor |
|---|---|
| 300.00 | 300.00 (already a multiple of 50, kept) |
| 300.01 | 350.00 |
| 320.00 | 350.00 |
| 349.99 | 350.00 |
| 350.00 | 350.00 (kept) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical base amounts)

1. A base amount of 300.00 and no percentage: 300.00.
2. A base amount of 300.00 with percentages of 7 and 4: one rate of 11 percent; 300.00 raised by 11 percent is 333.00; rounded up to 350.00.
3. A base amount of 400.00 raised by one rate of 25 percent: 500.00, already a multiple of 50, kept at 500.00.
